title: LeNet-5
description: The classic convolutional network for handwritten digits.
descriptionZh: 经典的手写数字卷积网络。

title: LSTM text classifier
description: Token embeddings, a bidirectional LSTM, mean pooling over time and a linear head.
descriptionZh: 词嵌入、双向 LSTM、按时间步平均池化，再接线性分类头。

title: MLP
description: Two hidden layers with ReLU and dropout, for 28×28 digits flattened to 784.
descriptionZh: 两个隐藏层，带 ReLU 与 Dropout，输入为展平的 28×28 手写数字。

title: Transformer encoder classifier
description: Token embeddings, two pre-norm Transformer encoder layers, mean pooling and a linear head.
descriptionZh: 词嵌入、两层 Pre-LN Transformer 编码层、平均池化，再接线性分类头。

title: Tiny U-Net
titleZh: 迷你 U-Net 分割网络
description: An encoder-decoder with skip connections joined by concatenation.
descriptionZh: 编码器-解码器结构，跳跃连接通过拼接汇合。

title: VGG-style CNN
description: Stacked 3×3 convolutions with batch norm, pooling and a dropout classifier.
descriptionZh: 堆叠的 3×3 卷积加批归一化与池化，分类头带 Dropout。
